related_questions.question: Can I get a copy of my immunization records online in Montana?

text_blocks.snippet: Yes, you can access your immunization records online in Montana through imMTrax, the state's immunization information system. imMTrax combines immunization records from various Montana healthcare providers and parental records into one secure, electronic system.
snippet_highlighted_words: Yes, you can access your immunization records online in Montana through imMTrax, the state's immunization information system

text_blocks.snippet: Here's how to get your records:

list.snippet: Check with your healthcare provider or local/tribal health department: They may be able to provide your immunization history directly.
If they can't help, request them through imMTrax: You can submit a request form to the Montana Immunization Program.
Consider using imMTrax for a complete record: If you have records from multiple sources (like different providers or schools), imMTrax can help consolidate them into one place.
If you received vaccines in another state or country: You may need to provide official documentation to have those records added to imMTrax.
